Looking Back, Moving Forward

About Me & My Journey

I believe every experience is a chance to grow. Whether learning something new, working with others, or taking on unfamiliar challenges, I strive to keep improving and becoming a better version of myself. I hope you enjoy reading my story as much as I've enjoyed living it.

'24
2024

Between the Dorms and the Market

During my time at PPMI Assalaam, my interest in the capital market began, driven by a simple curiosity about how people build wealth just by buying and selling stocks.

Honestly, it started with a simple curiosity: how could people build wealth just by buying and selling stocks? (At the time, I didn't understand the complexity of this) and that curiosity drove me to dig into the basics: what exactly are stocks? What is the capital market? Is it really just pure luck? Balancing this self-taught learning with my strict boarding school routines became the real starting point of my journey into the financial world.

Where It All Began

Graduating from PPMI Assalaam coincided with my most exciting financial moment yet, securing my first bagger with ANTM stock.

That incredible win fueled my drive to seriously generate income through the capital market. However, I knew I needed to sharpen my skills to go beyond just beginner's luck. This led me to pursue my studies at Universitas Brawijaya and join the IDX Investment Gallery FIA UB, where I could dive deeper into real market analytics.

The Learning Curve

A lot has changed this year, I transitioned from just studying the stock market to actually building my first equity research.

I'm still actively learning to improve my analysis, throwing myself into national and international competitions with my team just to expose my weaknesses and hone my skills. There is still a long way to go to master this craft. Stay tuned for the updates. Chao fellas!
